reviews.text:
It's best not to bring cats that aren't used to dogs.

I took my cat there because my previous cat was treated so well there 10 years ago. However, even after waiting for over an hour past my appointment time, it wasn't my turn. Dogs kept coming in and barking, and my cat was so frightened and trembling that I left without having her examined. There were signs in the clinic claiming to be cat-friendly, and it seemed like there was a room available, but we weren't shown to it, and the waiting area was very noisy with dogs barking loudly next door. Many of the pet owners were also very loud. Furthermore, the staff were unfriendly, and I was shocked after visiting again after 10 years. You should take your cat to a cat-only hospital.
I will never go there again. I should have read the reviews properly before coming.

This is a terrible animal hospital.
They have no understanding of the importance of life.
As others have posted,
This is a hospital that really only cares about making money.
If you truly consider your pet to be family, it's best not to take your pet there.

I have been using this veterinary hospital for over 25 years, starting with my previous dog. My previous dog had heart problems and died the morning after being brought to this hospital in a late-night emergency about 25 years ago. However, I felt that it was time for him to die, and they did their best to help him. Since then, they have helped my beloved dog through many crises. They are happy to trim senior dogs, and because they have been in business for a long time, they have connections with other dogs, so I think they are a reliable veterinary hospital.
The treatment was compassionate, and the post-mortem care was meticulous, showing warmth and consideration for both the animal and its owner.

This is the hospital that took such good care of my beloved dog until he passed away about three years ago.

They were always by my side for so many years, and I can't express how much support they provided.

Even during his hospitalization, there were always staff members present 24 hours a day, which gave me peace of mind, and they were able to help even when I rushed in in the middle of the night at the end of his life.

They even sent flowers for his memorial.

It may be expensive, but

It's a hospital that's worth more than that.

Even now, I feel nostalgic when I pass by it.

I'm truly grateful.

It feels like they're just trying to make money.

Their prices are higher than other hospitals.

Unfortunately, I didn't feel like they were thinking about my child's well-being.

Akasaka Animal Hospital Co., Ltd.
It's painfully obvious they only care about making money.
Just because it's a corporation doesn't mean it's a hospital for animals; it feels more like a business focused on making money.

Re-examination fees? They charge a hefty fee every time, and they charge 500 yen (excluding tax) each time if a staff member administers medication to a pet. We have no way of knowing if they actually administered it correctly.

Furthermore, they charge extra fees for after-hours visits and holidays.

They make us do unnecessary blood tests every time, charging nearly 20,000 yen.

This hospital (or rather, corporation) only cares about money.

The service is so terrible that I would not recommend this clinic to anyone who loves pets.
The other day, my cat suddenly started bleeding. …
My 84-year-old mother has some dementia. Four years ago, she and I, her daughter, decided to get a toy poodle puppy. His name is Pyonta. …
I live nearby, and when my beloved dog's condition suddenly worsened around 8pm, I frantically called them, only to be told they couldn't see me as it was after hours. …
It's polite and the sun is great!
